census.note: alpha x census values, makeup groups refitted on drafted games

blend.note: card terms shrunk toward alpha x census value

groupsOnly.note: makeup groups and the play only

transfer.note: sqrt(max(0, mean squared night-held-out residual - mean read variance)); the prediction's own bootstrap variance is not subtracted (it is carried separately in the intervals), so this is the transfer error plus the values' noise

cubes.idea: every class's cards near the highest level each colour can hold, valued in drafted context on the legacy + powered scale
every class's cards near 0 points (the legacy census's average card), valued in drafted context on the legacy + powered scale
every class's cards near the highest level each colour can hold, valued in drafted context on the pauper scale, pauper cards only where they fill the plan
